tri_budget.note: triangle limits; LOD0 100k -> 140k (owner/lead 2026-11-09, quality first, phone headroom: A16 Low cab GPU 16 ms / 33 ms), LOD1/LOD2 unchanged (Medium/Low)

unity_axes: +X right (passenger side), +Y up, +Z forward; driver at -X (LHD)
frame_mapping: A2/Blender (x, y, z) -> Unity (x, z, y); FBX axis_forward=Z, axis_up=Y, bake_space_transform, FBX_SCALE_ALL (same as the interior). Unity import: Scale Factor 1, Convert Units on, Bake Axis Conversion off. Positions below are in the Unity vehicle frame unless marked local.

origin.name: TruckExterior_LODn root
origin.note: ground under the rear axle centre = physics vehicle frame (VehicleModel, axles positionZ). Put the root at the vehicle body origin; CAB_Body moves with the cab suspension.

cab_body.note: parent CAB_Body_LODn and CabInterior_LODn under the same cab-suspension transform with localPosition 0: the interior then sits exactly in the exterior

rig_note: The FBX hierarchy is flat (all parts and sockets are direct children of the root; Blender's FBX exporter mis-writes deeper levels with bake_space_transform). Rebuild the rig from lods.LOD0.objects[*].rig_parent (keep world pose): CAB_Body carries doors, wipers, windscreen, mirrors; DOOR_x carries GLASS_Doorx; STEER_Fx carries WHEEL_Fx. For LOD1-3 parent each part mesh under the LOD0 transform of the same role and put the renderers in a LODGroup. LOD3 merges doors, wipers, door glass and mudflaps into CAB_Body / GLASS_Windscreen / CHASSIS and has no MIRROR_* quads (LOD2 neither).

lod_targets.LOD3: draft, not exported by default (~5k traffic LOD; wheels break at that budget)

hidden_faces.method: ray visibility from ~400 exterior points (3 rings x 24 azimuths, 0.3-8 m high, top views) + in-cab eye points; moving parts (doors, wheels, steering, wipers, mudflaps) tested only against themselves; glass treated as transparent

tiers.texture_compression: ASTC: C 6x6 (High) / 8x8, N 5x5 (High) / 6x6, M 8x8, Decal 6x6; all power-of-two squares, mipmaps on; N and M linear, C sRGB

shader_contract.name: Kamion/TruckExterior (Shader Graph, URP Lit opaque; Glass = transparent; MirrorRT = unlit RT)
shader_contract.uv0 'Atlas': unique atlas UV per slot (right wheels + right caliper reuse the left wheels' UVs mirrored)
shader_contract.uv1 'Decal': Paint slot: decal atlas UV (T_Ext_Decal); (0.002, 0.002) = transparent texel elsewhere. Lights slot (ADR 0181): lens frame, x = W_mm + u', y = style * 256 + H_mm + v' (u', v' = 0.02 + 0.96 * 0..1 across the lens; styles = lens_styles); floor(x) = 0 -> no lens
shader_contract.uv2 'Data': x = light group id (light_groups), y = emissive mask (1 on lamp emitters); 0 elsewhere
shader_contract.color 'Col': rgb: sRGB-encoded tint for Glass (windscreen green, lens clear), white elsewhere; a: IOR - 1 of the transparent surface (0.52 laminated glass, 0.59 polycarbonate lamp lens; 1 elsewhere). Glass shader: Fresnel F0 = ((n-1)/(n+1))^2, Schlick, smoothness 0.97 (lens 1.0); lamp lenses are real 6 mm shells (outer + inner face + rim), so they show two reflections and a lit edge
shader_contract.textures: T_Ext_<Slot>_C (RGB albedo sRGB, A roughness), _N (tangent normal, OpenGL +Y), _M (R AO, G dirt mask at full strength, B metallic; Paint: B = paint mask), all linear except C.rgb
shader_contract.albedo: C.rgb; Paint: C.rgb * _PaintColor; then lerp(albedo, _DirtColor, saturate(M.g * _Dirt)); Paint: lerp(albedo, _DecalColor, Decal.a)
shader_contract.metallic: M.b (Trim/Metal/Lights); Paint: _PaintMetallic * M.b, decal -> _DecalMetallic; then * (1 - saturate(M.g * _Dirt)) (dust is dielectric)
shader_contract.clear_coat: Paint: _ClearCoat * M.b (URP Complex Lit clear coat, optional on Medium/Low)
shader_contract.emission: Lights: _LightState[uv2.x] (RGB x intensity, 16x1 texture or array written by the light controller) * uv2.y; tail/brake share TAIL_BRAKE (tail ~0.25, brake 1.0)
shader_contract._Dirt: 0 = washed, 0.5 = look of the A4 renders, 1 = very dirty

urp_lit_fallback.note: stock URP Lit (no custom shader): _BaseMap = T_Ext_<Slot>_BaseMap[_<livery>] (albedo with _Dirt = 0.50 baked in, Paint per livery), _MetallicGlossMap AND _OcclusionMap = T_Ext_<Slot>_MaskMap[_<livery>] (R metallic, G AO, B dirt, A smoothness; Source = Metallic Alpha), _BumpMap = T_Ext_<Slot>_N. Loses: dirt slider, clear coat, TRAKT wordmark decal (uv1) and light states (emission).
urp_lit_fallback.glass: URP Lit Transparent, base colour = vertex colour tint not supported -> use (0.80, 0.86, 0.84, 0.22), smoothness 0.95

mirrors.note: MIRROR_* quads (uv0 0-1, u = local +X, v = local up) on the mirror glass, normal = local +Z (Unity) towards the driver's eye; same names as the interior manifest. With the exterior present, use these and disable the interior CAB_ShellPlaceholder + its MIRROR_* quads (one quad per mirror).
